ios.desc:
iGopherBrowser is a modern browser for Gopherspace, built for iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Vision Pro. It keeps the protocol simple while giving classic text archives, directories, and feeds a native Apple interface.

Browse Gopher menus, read documents, follow Floodgap feeds, and move through hosts with a clean toolbar, bookmarks, history, and share support. CRT mode adds amber phosphor text, scanlines, and a dark interface that makes ASCII art and old internet archives feel right at home.

Features:
- Native Gopher browsing for menus, text, and selectors
- Bookmarks and history for favorite hosts
- CRT display mode with amber styling
- Light and dark Liquid Glass interface
- Multimedia preview support where available
- Apple platform design across iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and visionOS

Whether you are exploring internet history, maintaining a Gopher tree, or just want a calmer way to read text-heavy spaces, iGopherBrowser gives Gopherspace a polished native home.
